name: execsql-syntax
description: Syntax highlighting, lint findings, completion, hover, navigation, quick fixes and formatting for execsql scripts.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace that is not trusted, the language server does not start; syntax highlighting still works. Trust the workspace to start it.

execsql.server.enabled.description: Start the execsql language server (execsql lsp) for SQL files. Syntax highlighting works without it.

execsql.server.path.description: The execsql command to run as `<path> lsp`: a command name looked up in PATH, or an absolute path (a leading ~ is expanded), e.g. ~/.local/bin/execsql. A relative path is refused.

execsql.server.logLevel.markdownDescription: How much the language server writes to **View → Output → execsql**: `info` adds a startup record (execsql version, Python, formatter) and each workspace folder's config files; `debug` adds every protocol message.

execsql.trace.server.description: Trace the messages between VS Code and the execsql language server in the execsql Output channel, for a bug report.
